subject: Quarterly slate & executive sponsor — aligning board-level slot and demo cadence
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@averytech.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Quarterly slate & executive sponsor — aligning board-level slot and demo cadence

Jordan — thanks again for the catch-up earlier this week. As we talked about, we'd like to lock in an executive-facing slot during your quarterly slate so Dawn (VP of Product) can see a concise board-level demo of the inference roadmap and proposed integration path.

High-level ask: 25–30 minute executive demo + 10 min Q&A (40 min total). We’ll include a 10–15 min technical deep-dive breakout for your eng/security folks after if helpful.

Weeks we are targeting: week of Aug 16 or week of Aug 23. Can you share Dawn’s availability (and any preferred time windows) so we can propose a firm slot? 

I’m copying Monica (customer success) and Ben (solutions engineer) — they’ll run the demo and the technical breakout. Soojin from security will stand by for any compliance questions.

Attached: draft agenda (QBR_Agenda_v2.pdf).

Thanks — happy to adjust cadence to what works best for your exec team.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
https://redwood.com
[Attachment: QBR_Agenda_v2.pdf (PDF)]

From: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@averytech.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@averytech.com; Dawn Lee <dawn.lee@averytech.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 14:05:12 +0000
Subject: Re: Quarterly slate & executive sponsor — aligning board-level slot and demo cadence

Aditya — thanks. Dawn's calendar is tight the week of Aug 16; she has a leadership offsite on the 16th and back-to-back reviews on the 17th. Her best windows are:

- Wed Aug 18, 14:00–15:00 PT
- Thu Aug 19, 09:00–10:00 PT

Either could work if we keep the session tight and focused to the exec summary + top 2 risks. Procurement is looped in on the CC for timeline/PO questions. Alex Rivera from Legal may need to join briefly on contract milestones.

Jordan
VP, Strategic Accounts | AveryTech
[jordan.mills@averytech.com]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 17:40:22 +0000
Subject: Fwd: Quarterly slate & executive sponsor — aligning board-level slot and demo cadence

Team — Jordan proposed two possible exec windows (Aug 18 14:00 PT or Aug 19 09:00 PT). We should lock one. Requests:

1) Ben — can you confirm SE availability for both windows and whether we can produce a 25-min board-level demo (slides + short live demo) that finishes with a 10-min Q&A?
2) Soojin — can you join the exec meeting for the top-level security posture and be available for the later technical breakout?
3) Monica — if Jordan confirms, can you set a short pre-call (15–20 min) with our team to align roles and run the demo script?

I’ve attached the draft agenda and included notes on which slides should be executive vs. technical. Also we need procurement readiness — Alex and the procurement contact are CC'd on the upstream thread.

Appreciate quick turnaround — Jordan is trying to lock Dawn's slot this week.

— Aditya

Date: Sat, 31 Jul 2027 11:22:04 +0000
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quarterly slate & executive sponsor — aligning board-level slot and demo cadence

Aditya — quick updates: Ben confirms availability for Wed Aug 18 14:00 PT. SE ask: we should plan for 25 min exec + 15 min Q&A to give Dawn a concise narrative and leave room for follow-ups. Ben will bring a short live demo showing throughput/latency for your production-like trace for 4–6 min, then hand off to the executive slide for ROI/ops.

Soojin can join both the exec slot and the technical breakout to cover compliance and data flow (SOC2 controls, encryption, data residency notes). She noted she needs the architecture diagram and a short list of customer questions in advance. I attached the technical roster with role names and contact numbers.

I’ll schedule a 20-min internal run on Tue Aug 16 to rehearse and align the transitions (Aditya/Ben/Soojin).

Thanks — Monica
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Technical_Roster.csv (CSV)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@averytech.com>, Dawn Lee <dawn.lee@averytech.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@averytech.com, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@averytech.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 09:55:00 +0000
Subject: Confirming Aug 18 exec slot + pre-call details

Jordan / Dawn — thanks for the windows. To confirm (proposed final):

- Event: Quarterly slate — Redwood executive summary + technical breakout
- Date/Time: Wed, Aug 18, 2027 14:00–14:40 PT (25 min exec demo + 15 min QA/buffer)
- Redwood attendees: Aditya Rao (AE), Ben Carter (SE), Monica Patel (CS), Soojin Lee (Security)
- AveryTech: Dawn Lee (VP), Jordan Mills (VP), Alex Rivera (Legal), procurement@averytech.com

Attachments: final agenda (QBR_Agenda_v2.pdf), technical roster (Technical_Roster.csv). I’ll send a calendar invite (Calendar_Invite.ics) and a short pre-call invite for Tue Aug 16 09:00 PT to run transitions.

Procurement — any outstanding items we should prepare ahead of the session (PO timing, contract milestones, or pre-approved SLAs)? We can surface a DocuSign link for the initial statement of work; linking here for convenience: https://app.docusign.com/AVT-4721/contract

If this works I’ll publish the invite and a 20-minute internal run for our team on Aug 16 at 09:00 PT.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachments: QBR_Agenda_v2.pdf, Technical_Roster.csv]
